$comment: Wire version 0.2, specification revision 0.2.1. Revisions add optional fields only.
title: ZHC Evidence Head v0.2
description: A company's signed statement of its evidence head (PROTOCOL §4.2). Ed25519 over the canonical JSON of payload, with a key from the company's evidence_keys.

company.description: The manifest id of the company whose books these are.

head.description: Hash of the last event in the log at `at`.

events.description: Number of events up to and including head.

kid.description: Key id from the company's evidence_keys.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of payload.
